title: Card-on-File Authorization Terms by Financial Class — Patient Financial Account
content:
Under these terms of the Patient Financial Account, a financial class may require the patient to keep a payment card on file for post-adjudication balances, may set a maximum amount charged automatically to that card for one encounter's post-adjudication balance (0.00 meaning no automatic charging), and may set a number of calendar days of advance notice given before the card on file is charged.

| Financial class (tier) | Card on file required | Maximum automatic charge per encounter (USD) | Advance notice before charging (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicaid Managed Care Account | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Self-Pay Account | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Medicare Part B Account | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage Account | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Commercial HMO/EPO Account | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| Commercial PPO/POS Account | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| High-Deductible Health Plan Account | yes | 750.00 | 5 |

**What the terms mean for each class.** The High-Deductible Health Plan Account is the class that requires a card on file; its maximum automatic charge is 750.00 per encounter and its advance notice is 5 calendar days. On the other six classes no card is required, the maximum automatic charge is 0.00 and the notice figure is 0.
